240-4460-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

141-1854-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-8095.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

341-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Umori.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

3197-3263-6830-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-3263-6830-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2762-5921-6792.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Mm'menon triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3490-5434-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-5434-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2511-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

856-2511-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6438-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6438-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

862-2438-5220-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1987-4045-4423-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2079-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
2079-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2033-2313-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2033-2313-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2033-2313-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4608-5775.notablePrerequisites:
Fortune does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-5775.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Exchange of Words, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker.
At the end of your combat phase, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

586-2146-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-1283-1545-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
413-1283-1545-4078-4242.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

38-876-4763.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Skirk Prospector.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Koll triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Skirk Prospector by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1455-1744-2523-4365.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Mondrak.
Vesuvan Duplimancy triggers, creating two nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak.
Resolve Rite of Replication, creating eight copies of Mondrak.
Put all but one legendary Mondrak into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Mondraks die, Ratadrabik triggers eight times.
Resolve the first Ratadrabik trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak equal to 2^(the number of Mondraks you currently control) that are 2/2 Zombies in addition to their other types.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

1987-2510-3277-3573.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2510-3277-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

411-913-2510-4893.notablePrerequisites: Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
411-913-2510-4893.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.

45-813-1518-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
45-813-1518-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
